DILG BACONC muptNAS Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilg.gov.ph OILG OPINION NO n s. 2629 FEB 24 2025 JONATHAN G. ERAN City Councilor Sipalay City, Negros Occidental Dear Hon. Eran: This has reference to the letter received by the Department last 27 December 2024 requesting for clarification and legal opinion regarding the permanent vacancy in Barangay Council of Barangay Nabulao. With the existence of two (2) permanent vacancies in the barangay council. the members have proposed through a formal session for the appointment of Ms. Jenny Lyn Eran, the daughter of the late Punong Barangay Joebart Eran. Ms. Eran, per your representations, meets all the legal qualifications for the position, including legal age, residency of at least six (6), and other statutory requirements. However, the Punong Barangay has consistently refused to act on these recommendations. Hence, the following issues were raised, to wit: (I) Is it within the legal authority of Punong Barangay Enrile Elarcosa to impose his own qualifications for candidates, such as requiring them to have been his allies in the past election or not be critical of his leadership? (2) Is it lawful for Punong Barangay Enrile Elarcosa to refuse to sign resolutions duly approved by the Barangay Council recommending the appointment of Ms. Jenny Lyn Eran? (3) Does the inaction of Punong Barangay Enrile Elarcosa on the pending resolutions constitute a legal violation, particularly if the refusal is based solely on the candidate not meeting his personal qualifications? (4) Could Punong Barangay Enrile Elarcosa be held administratively or criminally liable for disregarding the "Majority Rule" principle upheld by the Barangay Council? (5) What will happen to the resolution approved by the majority of the members if left unsigned because of his refusal, would it still be valid? (6) Is this action of him tantamount to Dereliction of Duty and Gross Negligence? At the outset, please be informed that the term "barangay council" is officially referred to as the "Sangguniang Barangay." For the purposes of this legal opinion, we will use this proper nomenclature throughout the discussion. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline NO. (02) 8876-3454

Pursuant to Chapter II, Sec. 45 (3)1 of the Local Govemment Code (LGC), in case of the permanent vacancy in the Sangguniang Barangay, the City/MunicipaI Mayor shall upon the recommendation of the sangguniang barangay, appoint a qualified person to fill the vacancy2. The use of the word "shall" means that the recommendation of the concerned sangguniang barangay is mandatory, being an element in the process of the appointment by the city or municipal mayor. Since this duty is mandatory, the Sangguniang Barangay is obliged to comply. Otherwise, noncompliance shall be tantamount to dereliction of duty which is a ground for disciplinary action provided in sec. 60 of RA 71603. Sec. 49 of the LGC provides that the punong barangay shall act as the presiding officer of the sangguniang barangay and shall vote only to break a tie.4 Thus, in the absence of a tie, it shall be the punong barangay's duty to acknowledge the resolution recommending the appointment of Ms. Jenny Lyn Eran and forward the same to the mayor. As regards the 2nd, Yd, 4th and 6th questions, we opine that such refusal is tantamount to abuse of authority. Finally, this opinion is based solely on the facts and representations narrated from the letter and our appreciation of the same. Further, this opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you on this matter. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. ROMEO P. ENITEZ Undersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSE-LNJRULLLS-LRALLD/SWOD 1 SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. (a) Permanent vacancies in the Sanggunian where automatic successions provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: xxx (c) In case the permanent vacancy is caused by a Sanggunian member who does not belong to any political party, the local chief executive shall, upon recommendation of the Sanggunian concerned, appoint a qualified person to fill the vacancy. 2 MC 2022-130 dated 6 October 2022. Presiding Officer. - (a) The vice-governor shall be the presiding officer of the sangguniang panlalawigan; the city vice- mayor, of the sangguniang panlungsod; the municipal vice-mayor, of the sangguniang bayan; and the punong barangay, of the sangguniang barangay. The presiding officer shall vote only to break a tie. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline NO. (02) 8876-3454
